title: Dalrymple ESCRI-SA Battery Energy Storage System: Phase 56H Evidence Decision
summary: AEMO's February 2026 report identifies the Dalrymple Battery islanding constraint S_DLBAT-G_ISL and records 20 dispatch intervals, or 1.66 hours, in which that constraint equation was violated. Phase 56H decision: The asset-specific event count deepens the later operating record, but the evidence state remains Partially Closed because a constraint violation is not an islanding activation, availability series, or dispatch history.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Post-project availability, dispatch, and islanding events.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when ElectraNet, AGL, AEMO, ARENA, or the South Australian regulator publishes dated islanding activations or an asset-level operating series.
why_it_matters: The record tests a named acquisition or reopening rule while keeping adjacent context separate from exact operating, corrective-action, or closure evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Records the official rail, compatible observation, and decision at a date.
Separates evidence-state movement from entity performance, quality, readiness, or value.
evidence_limits: Constraint-equation violation intervals do not establish actual islanding, delivered service, full dispatch, availability, degradation, revenue, or customer outcomes.
Post-2021 availability, dispatch, realized islanding activations, state of charge, degradation, revenue, reliability, and customer outcomes.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
